World.title: World
World.description: A shared or personal voxel sandbox world generated from a procedural seed with Game Tick, Chunk, and SRF settings.

name.description: Display name of the world (1-60 chars).

seed.description: 64-bit integer seed used for procedural terrain and biome generation.

gameMode.description: Default game mode for the world.

ownerId.description: UID of the user who created the world.

ownerName.description: Display name of the world creator.

isPublic.description: Whether the world is joinable in the public multiplayer lobby.

blockEditCount.description: Total number of modified blocks saved in the world.

parasiteEvolutionPhase.description: Current Scape and Run: Parasites (SRP/SRF) evolution phase (0-5).

raidStackedWaves.description: Current Stacking Raid Farm (SRF) active stacked waves.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the world was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the world was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

BlockDelta.title: BlockDelta
BlockDelta.description: A single modified block in a world chunk, synchronized in real time across multiplayer clients and cached offline.

blockKey.description: Deterministic coordinate key in the form x_y_z.

y.description: World Y vertical coordinate (0 to 384, matching chunk height).

blockType.description: Block material identifier (e.g., AIR, GRASS, STONE, OAK_LOG, DIAMOND_ORE, RAID_BEACON, SLIME_CORE, PARASITE_BIOMASS).

updatedBy.description: UID of the player who placed or mined the block.

updatedByName.description: Display name of the player who modified the block.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the block modification (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

PlayerPresence.title: PlayerPresence
PlayerPresence.description: Real-time multiplayer player position, game mode, health/hunger telemetry, and active tool in a shared world.

worldId.description: ID of the world the player is currently exploring.

isFlying.description: Whether the player is currently using free flight.

heldItem.description: Currently equipped block or crafted tool.

/worlds/{worldId}.description: Stores shared multiplayer and personal voxel worlds.

/worlds/{worldId}/blocks/{blockKey}.description: Stores real-time block modifications (placed or mined blocks) within a world.

/worlds/{worldId}/players/{playerId}.description: Stores real-time multiplayer player coordinates, health, hunger, and flight status in a world.
